description: Machine-readable registry of all 37 integrity gates across GSE architecture

gates.name: canScore
gates.checks: Whether the scoring engine is authorized to compute game probability models

gates.name: canPersistPicks
gates.checks: Whether generated picks are authorized to be written to persistent database storage

gates.name: canPersistCanonicalHistory
gates.checks: Controls canonical history ledger recording vs synthetic bootstrap mode

gates.name: canUseDerivedHistory
gates.checks: Enables usage of derived model historical metrics in live scoring

gates.name: canExposePublicPicks
gates.checks: Public pick board gating (GAP-21 reconciled); fails closed 503 when off

gates.name: canPromoteFeaturedPicks
gates.checks: Auto-promotes qualified high-edge picks to the featured board spotlight

gates.name: canPublishContent
gates.checks: Authorizes automated public blog and analysis syndication generation

gates.name: canExposePerformanceStats
gates.checks: Authorizes display of cumulative performance track records to public viewers

gates.name: canLearnFromOutcomes
gates.checks: Authorizes online learning feedback from settled games into model parameters

gates.name: canApplyCalibrationAdjustments
gates.checks: Applies isotonic and PAVA calibration adjustments onto raw model confidences

gates.name: forceNoBetIfStale
gates.checks: Stale-data kill switch returning 503 when live odds feed exceeds SLA threshold

gates.name: minDataQualityForGameLog
gates.checks: Minimum data quality threshold (score >= 40) required to persist team game logs

gates.name: assertDisplaySubstantiated
gates.checks: Enforces Wilson score lower confidence bound and provenance on public marketing claims

gates.name: publicCommitPick
gates.checks: Generates irreversible SHA-256 cryptographic commitment hash prior to event kickoff

gates.name: noBetEvaluation
gates.checks: Detects unstable edges and advises PASS when model confidence is fragile or inverted

gates.name: runShuffledTimePlacebo
gates.checks: Verifies that temporally shuffled data produces zero statistically significant edge

gates.name: validateWalkForwardIntegrity
gates.checks: Enforces strict temporal embargo and purge windows preventing future information leakage

gates.name: evaluatePromotion
gates.checks: 3-leg promotion protocol requiring N >= 500 settled games and delta Brier >= 0.002

gates.name: lineIntegrityPublishGuard
gates.checks: Suppresses picks when bookmakers have not actively quoted the line

gates.name: leakageClean
gates.checks: Detects and penalizes factor weights derived from lookahead features

gates.name: mintWithholdGate
gates.checks: Withholds uncalibrated or fragile signal slates from publication during minting

gates.name: publishGuardsBridge
gates.checks: Bridges prediction engine honesty guards into ingestion pipeline publication path

gates.name: draftOnlyGuardrail
gates.checks: Static AST scanner blocking direct public publication writes without explicit authorization

gates.name: trustGateBannedPhrases
gates.checks: Scans codebase to reject deceptive marketing terminology and non-probabilistic claims

gates.name: unenforcedThresholdsAuditor
gates.checks: Verifies AST threshold comparisons across 187 mathematical constants ensuring zero dead exports

gates.name: classACoverageCheck
gates.checks: Asserts zero data leakage and 100% test coverage across Class-A literature premises

gates.name: g7CalibrationCircuitBreaker
gates.checks: Automatically halts pick emissions on any market family where ECE_30 - ECE_250 > 0.02

gates.name: g1SampleFloorCoverage
gates.checks: Enforces N >= 30 sample floor and Cov_sig >= 0.65 signal family coverage

gates.name: g2ConsensusDeadband
gates.checks: Enforces conflict consensus deadband eta_c >= 0.20 and verified Class-A literature

gates.name: g3PearlIdentifiability
gates.checks: Requires 0 unhandled hedges and positivity > 0.01 via Shpitser-Pearl do-calculus ID

gates.name: g4AdversaryEValue
gates.checks: Requires point E-value >= 1.35, CI >= 1.10, and placebo leakage <= 0.005

gates.name: g5FaithfulnessEntitySwap
gates.checks: Requires entity-swap divergence <= 0.02 and CausalPhys reasoning accuracy >= 0.85

gates.name: g6ConformalStopping
gates.checks: Enforces ITCR stopping alpha <= tau_conformal and Fréchet copula bounds

gates.name: g7CalibrationDrift
gates.checks: Halts picks when fast-vs-slow ECE drift exceeds 0.02

gates.name: g8ClvTrailingEdge
gates.checks: Requires 50-game trailing CLV >= -0.002 and lower conformal bound edge > 0.015

gates.name: g9PriceArchiveWriteReceipt
gates.checks: Synchronously validates durable fsync receipt of decision-time price archive write

gates.name: validatedCausalTraceBrand
gates.checks: Compile-time unique symbol phantom brand rejecting unbranded or withheld traces at build time
